facts.raw_span: A 53-year-old man
history of hypertension, hyperlipidemia, diabetes mellitus type 2, heart failure with recovered ejection fraction
left arm and left leg weakness that began 90 minutes before
sneezed and felt pain throughout the head then developed tingling and weakness in the left arm and left leg
cardiac magnetic resonance imaging showed an ejection fraction of 30% with global hypokinesis
underwent CABG with Impella 5.5 support
Blood pressure: 146/85 mm Hg
Heart rate: 87 beats/min
Oxygen saturation: 97% on room air
CT scan of head and CT angiography of head and neck: negative for any acute findings
CT angiography of chest: revealed an intraluminal clot in the thoracic aorta
MRI of brain: showed multiple acute embolic infarcts
